I ran `op run -- env` & checked the output < 10 lines [1]. The docs are at https://developer.1password.com/docs/cli/ and [the guide](https://example.com/guide).

## Setting it up

1. Install the CLI:

   ```sh
   brew install 1password-cli
   ```

2. Check the version, which wraps
   onto a second line.
3. Run it.

### What it printed

```text
<vault id>   Agents
```

> A quoted line from the spec,
> continued here.

- one ends in a bare URL, https://example.com/a.
- (see https://example.com/b), or https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Foo_(bar).
- two with `code`
